title: Complete quadratic linear PCPP description
statement: For each positive integer $n$, there exists a probabilistically checkable proof description for Boolean strings whose complete quadratic bit is $1$. The proof has length $n+2(n+1)$, the verifier makes $3$ queries, and the rejection rate is $1/12$.
